notes.title: The October Next Fest event is underway.
notes.content:
Umai Neko's new game, Fighting Girl Yuri, will be participating in this Next Fest.

Add it to your wishlist, download the demo version, and give it a try. After playing, leave a review and you'll be entered into a draw to win a CD-Key for the playtest. We look forward to your participation. Thank you!
